Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/capstonenext && python3 - <<'PY'
import os, subprocess, itertools, tempfile, time
p='/tmp/csx'
def test(case):
 open(p,'wb').write(case)
 r=subprocess.run(['./build/fuzz_disasm',p],env=dict(os.environ,MSAN_OPTIONS='exit_code=86:halt_on_error=1'),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=3)
 if r.returncode:
  print('BAD',r.returncode,case.hex(),len(case)); print((r.stdout+r.stderr).decode('latin1','replace')[:12000]); return True
 return False
cnt=0
# targeted prefixes/opcodes x86 with 64/32
prefixes=[b'',b'\xf0',b'\xf2',b'\xf3',b'\x66',b'\x67',b'\x0f',b'\x0f\x38',b'\x0f\x3a',b'\xc4\x00\x00',b'\xc5\x00',b'\x62\x00\x00\x00']
for arch in [0,1]:
 for pref in prefixes:
  for op in range(256):
   for tail in [b'',b'\x00',b'\xc0',b'\xff',b'\x00\x00\x00\x00',b'\xff\xff\xff\xff',b'\x00'*8]:
    if test(bytes([arch])+pref+bytes([op])+tail): raise SystemExit
    cnt+=1
 print('done targeted arch',arch,cnt,flush=True)
# random x86
import random
for n in range(100000):
 arch=random.choice([0,1])
 l=random.randint(1,15)
 data=os.urandom(l)
 # bias prefixes
 if random.random()<0.4:
  data=random.choice(prefixes)+data
 case=bytes([arch])+data[:15]
 if test(case): raise SystemExit
 if n and n%5000==0: print('random',n,flush=True)
print('no bad',cnt)
